description: Meet the Stinger. ReActive Adaptations has been receiving requests for its creation for years. The only of its kind on the market, this three-wheeled foot-pedaled recumbent is an actual off-road demon. With 26-inch wheels capped in the meanest knobbies, the Stinger has the ground clearance and traction enough to conquer any rocky, root-filled trail in your back yard or the mountains. Though the real key here is the derailleur. Other tadpole recumbents on the market available to the “off road” world often have low hanging derailleurs. Mounted on the 26-inch rear wheel, the Stinger’s derailleur is free from many trail collisions that leave its predecessors stranded.
